Experts in human, small animal & equine physiotherapy.

​​Based just outside Wellington, Somerset our clients come from all reaches of the South-West. And beyond. A tight-knit team of highly qualified physiotherapists in a state of the art clinic set up to deliver gold standard physiotherapy and rehabilitation to all our clients.

Specialists in Canine Agility

At the Win Clinic, we have many years of experience working with agility dogs of all levels and experience. We have worked with two GB teams and we work with multiple GB partnerships.
